messages:
nate: FYI opened a docs PR for metering + tier examples — https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4873. Need a quick review on the 'burst credits' wording and the new tier table. Also includes SDK snippet migration from v1 -> v2.

ashley: on it. will take a pass this morning. are we keeping the "tokens-per-unit" phrasing or moving to "compute units"? left a couple inline comments in the PR.

dina: quick q — for the SDK snippets, should examples be JS-first? product asked for js-first quickstart.

nate: yes js-first, then python. also make sure the header example shows `X-Redwood-Plan` for quota mapping.

mohammed: found a broken link in the billing section: `/console/billing` -> should be `/console/usage/billing`. I'll push a tiny patch to redirect the link.

ashley: good catch. also the rate-limit example has `429Retry-After` typo in the response sample — should be the standard `Retry-After` header.

sam: docs-bot preview is up: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/4873 — noticed the tier table wraps badly on mobile (cells don't break).

nate: I added a CSS tweak for table-word-break. also added a migration note: "If you counted on per-minute quotas, map them to the new per-second SLO + burst credits" — can someone sanity-check the example mapping?

dina: wording looks fine but add an explicit mapping example. suggestion: paste this snippet into the migration section:

```
# migration example
# old: 600 requests / minute
# new: 10 requests / second with a 60-request burst credit pool
OLD: 600/min -> NEW: 10/s (burst=60)
```

mohammed: LGTM from infra side. I'll update the dashboard link and push the fixes. @ashley can you re-run the l10n checks after merge?

ashley: running l10n now. one small nit: we use both "metering window" and "billing window" in the doc; I normalized to "metering window" per style guide.

docs-bot: CI checks passed for PR #4873 — spelling, links, l10n. merge queued for 09:30 UTC.

nate: thanks everyone :tada:

ashley: quick follow-up — added a tiny JS snippet for showing how to set the plan header in the SDK:

```js
// JS SDK example (v2)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });

await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood-medium',
  prompt: 'hello',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Plan': 'pro-monthly' }
});
```

nate: perfect. after merge I'll open a follow-up to add a short note in the billing FAQ about mapping legacy quotas.

mohammed: merging now. ping if anything breaks in the preview.
